reason: Original Python checker added 1 microsecond to freshness eligibility. Port uses unsigned integer age after float32 timestamp multiplication/truncation. At now=16800 and stored stamp=16.049999237060547 the port age is 751 ms; tolerance incorrectly included this candidate. Corrected checker reproduces the actual declared representation.
boundary_limitation: Float timestamp representation and truncation can exclude a beacon about 1 ms earlier than its ideal integer acquisition timestamp. Reported as a port limitation.
